description: CAP (Solicitud Unica) slot schema. Deterministic source of truth for which fields the agent may populate; the LLM may only propose values for fields listed here.

slots.name: beneficiary.full_name
slots.question_es: ¿A nombre de quien se solicita la ayuda?
slots.question_en: Who is the aid requested for?

slots.name: beneficiary.iban
slots.question_es: ¿Cual es la cuenta bancaria (IBAN) para el pago?
slots.question_en: What is the bank account (IBAN) for payment?

slots.name: parcels[].parcel_id
slots.question_es: ¿Cual es el identificador SIGPAC de la parcela (poligono, parcela y recinto)?
slots.question_en: What is the SIGPAC parcel identifier (polygon, plot and enclosure)?

slots.name: parcels[].declared_crop
slots.question_es: ¿Que cultivo o aprovechamiento declara en la parcela?
slots.question_en: Which crop or land use do you declare on the parcel?

slots.name: parcels[].declared_surface_ha
slots.question_es: ¿Cual es la superficie declarada en hectareas?
slots.question_en: What is the declared surface in hectares?

slots.name: parcels[].irrigation_type
slots.question_es: ¿La parcela es de secano o de regadio?
slots.question_en: Is the parcel rainfed or irrigated?

slots.name: requested_aid_lines
slots.question_es: ¿Que lineas de ayuda desea solicitar (ecorregimenes, AKR, ayudas directas)?
slots.question_en: Which aid lines do you want to apply for (eco-schemes, AKR, direct aids)?

slots.name: eco_schemes[].practice_code
slots.question_es: ¿Que codigo de practica del ecorregimen quiere solicitar?
slots.question_en: Which eco-scheme practice code do you want to apply for?

slots.name: eco_schemes[].applied_surface_ha
slots.question_es: ¿Cual es la superficie que solicita para esa practica?
slots.question_en: Which surface do you request for that practice?
